meet.title: Where we’ll meet
meet.subtitle: Timing and meeting point to be confirmed
meet.description: Confirm the meeting time and place with our team. If your package includes transport, we will coordinate your pickup; if you arrive independently, use these directions to the launch site.

thinks.subtittle1: We’ll ask for basic information such as weight, age, and relevant medical conditions so we can operate safely.

thinks.subtittle2: Light activity. You’ll need to stand during the flight and enter and exit the basket with assistance from our team.

thinks.subtittle3: Comfortable clothing, closed-toe shoes, and a light jacket for the early morning.

thinks.subtittle4: If weather conditions do not allow us to fly safely, we’ll help you reschedule according to our policy.

footer.title: Flight Experiences Safely Designed
footer.description: Choose a shared flight or a private experience and review your package’s services. Our team will help confirm the details of your visit.
